column3: Close to the Greek; “signs” is rendered “miracles.”
NKJV has “great joy,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “much joy.”
NKJV has “the great power of God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the power of God that is called Great.”
NKJV includes “Holy,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Spirit was given.”
Close to the Greek; “authority” is rendered “power.”
NKJV has “pray God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “pray to the Lord.”
NKJV renders “in the gall of bitterness and the bond of iniquity” as “poisoned by bitterness and bound by iniquity.”
